SubmitExecutionRequest.description:
The execution gateway derives the private staging namespace from
`workspace_id` and `submit_intent_id`. command contains the complete frozen
input and effective parameters. command_digest is SHA-256 over RFC 8785
canonical command JSON; mismatch is invalid_execution_request. Same intent
with a different canonical command is submit_intent_conflict. Callers cannot supply an output object
key, path prefix, bucket, or external URL. Input storage references must
identify immutable owned assets and match the command workspace.

max_output_audio_ms.description:
Hard output-audio ceiling for stages that synthesize audio. Use
null for ASR, alignment, and other stages that cannot emit audio.
The referenced manifest stage must declare `emits_audio_pcm=true`
for a non-null value. The gateway stores
`hard_output_ceiling_samples` as
`floor(max_output_audio_ms * sample_rate_hz / 1000)`. A manifest
stage that emits audio PCM rejects a null value.

sample_rate_hz.description:
PCM sample rate used for output metering. Required and non-null
exactly when `max_output_audio_ms` is non-null; null for text-only
stages.

External_shared_identifiers_schema_json_.description: Opaque stable resource identifier. Prefixes are descriptive, not authorization claims.
Logical capability resource pool identifier. Pools may span multiple host nodes.
Monotonic decimal revision represented as a string.

dispatched_at.description:
Set when the gateway starts the engine request. Null before dispatch
and for failures that never dispatched.

ExecutionState.description:
Authoritative execution state on the gateway. `submitting` and `unknown_quarantined`
continue to hold reserved capacity until stop evidence is confirmed.

ExecutionStateInvariants.description:
Closed execution-state to cleanup-state matrix. Active states still own
capacity. A successful execution has completed cleanup. A failed
execution may clean up without a dispatched request (`not_required`) or
only after verified termination (`complete`); an unknown execution must
use `unknown_quarantined` together with quarantined cleanup.

ExecutionCleanupEvidenceInvariants.description:
A failed execution may use `cleanup_state=not_required` only when no
request reached the engine. `engine_request_id` and `dispatched_at` are
therefore required and null for that branch; omitting either would make
dispatch history ambiguous and could release capacity while an engine
request is still active.

ExecutionDispatchEvidenceInvariants.description:
Submission is persisted before an engine request. Active execution,
and successful completion require an observed dispatch time. `submitting`
and a failure that never dispatched require
it to be null. An unknown quarantined execution may have an ambiguous
dispatch outcome and keeps capacity quarantined either way. An abort with
no observed dispatch time is allowed only with verified whole-instance
termination evidence; recovery must not invent a dispatch time.

output_watermark.description:
Null for text-only stages. Otherwise its sample_rate_hz must equal
the response-level sample_rate_hz and its generated_pcm_samples must
not exceed hard_output_ceiling_samples when that ceiling is set.

OutputWatermark.description:
Monotonic high-water summary over the authoritative interval ledger.
`generated_pcm_samples` and `sample_rate_hz` are authoritative; audio
milliseconds are derived only for reporting as
`floor(generated_pcm_samples * 1000 / sample_rate_hz)` and are not a
stored or independently mutable meter. When
`hard_output_ceiling_samples` is non-null it must be greater than or
equal to `generated_pcm_samples`.

ExecutionTerminalEvidenceInvariants.description:
Terminal status must expose evidence consistent with its result.
A successful execution has an engine terminal response and no error. A
failed execution must carry a stable error code and either have no
dispatched request or verified termination evidence.

enforced_at.description: Time of this successful enforcement confirmation. Replay may refresh inventory and this time while preserving the same durable minimum and proof.
